# backup_game_files

[← Command index](README.md)

Download store purchases whose build has changed and upload them, encrypted, to a locker.

## Synopsis

```
backup_game_files [options]
```

## Description

Selects games from the game JSON metadata, not from the locker. For each game on a
store platform that supports downloading purchases (Amazon Games, Epic Games, GOG,
Humble Bundle, Itchio, Legacy Games, Steam), it asks the store for the latest build.
When that differs from the build recorded in the game's JSON, it downloads the
purchase to a temporary directory and hands it to the same encrypt, hash and upload
steps as `upload_game_files`.

Games on other platforms are skipped without doing anything.

In `Standard` mode the games are those in the JSON metadata, narrowed by `-u`, `-c`,
`-s` and `-n` (an exact game name). In `Custom` mode `-c`, `-s` and `-n` are required
and name exactly one game.

## Options

### Game selection

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-u, --game_supercategory <game_supercategory>` | Supercategory of the games to back up. Default: `Roms`. Allowed: `Assets`, `Emulators`, `Roms`, `DLC`, `Updates`, `Tags`, `Saves`, `Setup`, `Installs`. |
| `-c, --game_category <game_category>` | Category of the games to back up; all categories when omitted in `Standard` mode. Allowed: `Computer`, `Microsoft`, `Nintendo`, `Other`, `Sony`. |
| `-s, --game_subcategory <game_subcategory>` | Subcategory (platform or store) of the games to back up; all of the category's subcategories when omitted in `Standard` mode. PlayStation 3`, `Sony PlayStation Network - PlayStation 4`, `Sony PlayStation Network - PlayStation Portable`, `Sony PlayStation Network - PlayStation Portable Minis`, `Sony PlayStation Network - PlayStation Vita`, `Sony PlayStation Portable`, `Sony PlayStation Portable Video`, `Sony PlayStation Vita`. |
| `-n, --game_name <game_name>` | Exact name of the game to back up; every game found when omitted in `Standard` mode. |

### Output

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-l, --locker_type <locker_type>` | Locker to upload to; its passphrase encrypts the files. Allowed: `All`, `Local`, `Hetzner`, `Gdrive`, `External`. |

### Common options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-v, --verbose` | Enable verbose mode. |
| `-p, --pretend_run` | Do a pretend run with no permanent changes. |
| `-x, --exit_on_failure` | Enable exit on failure mode. |
| `--no-preview` | Skip the preview confirmation prompt. |

## Examples

### Back up every changed Steam purchase to Hetzner

```bash
backup_game_files -c Computer -s Steam -l Hetzner
```

### Preview a backup without downloading or uploading anything

```bash
backup_game_files -c Computer -s GOG -l Hetzner -p -v
```

### Back up one GOG game

```bash
backup_game_files -c Computer -s GOG -n "Game Name" -l Hetzner
```

## Notes

- Only `Computer` store subcategories do anything; the tool checks every selected game against its store, which can take a while without `-c` and `-s`.
- The first game that fails stops the run.
